# Bundled renderer

This is the unmodified single-file CLI from [Answer Me with HTML v0.6.4](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html/tree/v0.6.4/skills/answer-me-with-html) (Git blob `7c1cc82fde33ab3a0caf1b439e73256fd6978209`). The renderer is MIT licensed.

`licenses/` contains the upstream notice and the licenses for the dependencies bundled at that tag.

| Dependency | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| @dagrejs/dagre | 3.1.3 | MIT |
| @dagrejs/graphlib | 4.0.6 | MIT |
| marked | 18.2.0 | MIT |
| temml | 0.14.0 | MIT, with portions under Apache-2.0 as noted in the bundle |
| @fontsource/bangers | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL-1.1 |

Keep the CLI and notices together when refreshing the pinned upstream version.
